method.event_identity: first path component after /broadcast/ in PGN BroadcastURL; records without a BroadcastURL are grouped by Event and Site and remain unresolved
method.external_sources: event website or standings URL linked from official tournament metadata; response content hashes and matched terms are recorded
method.metadata_source: Lichess Broadcast API tournament metadata plus source PGN event, site, and broadcast URL tags
method.unresolved: metadata is unavailable, or event and venue cannot be independently corroborated from linked event sources
method.verified_online: official tournament metadata or repeated PGN Event, Site, and BroadcastURL fields contain an explicit online, internet, or computer-engine marker; engine tournament identifiers are also recorded
method.verified_otb: official broadcast metadata reports a physical location and a linked event or standings page independently contains both tournament identity terms and location terms
